units.source_text: 这样的少年抱有两种相反的权力意志。

en.t: Such a boy harbored two opposing wills to power.

units.source_text: 这是很容易想像出来的。

en.t: This is very easy to imagine.

units.source_text: 我喜欢阅读有关历史上暴君的书。

en.t: I liked reading books about tyrants in history.

units.source_text: 倘使我是个结巴而寡言的暴君，那么家属们窥见我的脸色，就会终日战战兢兢地生活。

en.t: If I were a stammering and taciturn tyrant, then my family, watching my expression, would live all day long in trembling fear.

units.source_text: 我没有必要用明确而流畅的语言来使我的残暴正当化，因为只要我寡言就可以使一切残暴正当化。

en.t: I had no need to justify my cruelty with clear and fluent language, because my silence alone could justify every act of cruelty.

units.source_text: 这样，我总乐于幻想把平日藐视我的教师和同学一个个地处以刑罚。

en.t: In this way, I always took pleasure in imagining that I punished, one by one, the teachers and classmates who usually looked down on me.

units.source_text: 我还乐于幻想我成为内心世界的国王，成为冷静观察的大艺术家。

en.t: I also took pleasure in imagining myself becoming the king of an inner world, a great artist of calm observation.

units.source_text: 尽管我表面很贫穷，可精神世界却比谁都富有。

en.t: Although outwardly I was very poor, my spiritual world was richer than anyone else's.

units.source_text: 少年抱有一种难以排除的自卑感，认为自己是被悄悄挑选出来的，这不也是理所当然的吗？

en.t: Is it not only natural that a boy with an ineradicable sense of inferiority should believe he had been secretly chosen?

units.source_text: 我总觉得这个世界的海角天涯，存在着我自己尚未知晓的使命在等待着我。

en.t: I always felt that somewhere at the farthest ends of this world, a mission I myself did not yet know was waiting for me.
